notes: One working week, Monday 2026-02-09 to Friday 2026-02-13, from Juliet Capulet's journal. Times are local (America/Denver). Each entry is one segment. 'audio' entries are spoken (meetings, calls, voice memos); 'screen' entries are Juliet's screen while she writes or works. Durations are targets in seconds; audio length is whatever the script produces. Wednesday, the hero day, is a full ordinary working day: Juliet's screen in five-minute segments from about 8 to 6, with her meetings and calls alongside, the way a real owner's day fills a journal.

entries.title: Voice memo: plan for the week
entries.beats: Juliet, walking in, lists the week: Balcony App 3.0 beta go/no-go Friday; Schema Bridge kickoff with Montague today; Ducal Freight call Wednesday; weekly note to Friar Friday. Reminds herself to book the Paris trade-show flight for the 26th.

entries.title: Capulet standup
entries.beats: Balcony App 3.0 beta status: 41 testers, two crash reports on older Android, offline-sync bug Balthasar found. Angela owns the release checklist and proposes Friday 9:30 for go/no-go. Tybalt raises worry about Schema Bridge depending on Montague's Mesh Routing uptime. Juliet: let's raise it with Romeo in the kickoff.

entries.title: Writing the Schema Bridge spec, draft 1
entries.beats: Juliet types a doc 'Schema Bridge: draft 1' with sections Goal, Inspection record (fields: site_id, inspector, photos, findings, signed_at), Sync (Balcony to Mesh Routing, nightly batch), Open questions (who owns field versioning? what if Mesh Routing is down?).

entries.title: Schema Bridge kickoff with Montague
entries.beats: Introductions, scope. Romeo proposes events instead of nightly batch. Benvolio sets a Friday demo for Ducal Freight. Juliet raises Tybalt's uptime concern; Romeo offers a local queue so Balcony keeps working when Mesh Routing is down. Open question left: who owns field versioning. Action items: Juliet spec v2 by Wednesday, Romeo prototype the queue.

entries.title: 1:1 with Friar (Verona Ventures)
entries.beats: Friar asks about the Montague partnership; advises a written agreement on who owns the shared format before Ducal sees a demo. Talks runway lightly (no numbers). Suggests Juliet send a short weekly note. Juliet agrees to send one Friday.

entries.title: Balcony App 3.0 beta release notes
entries.beats: Juliet writes beta release notes: offline inspections, faster photo upload, signed reports; known issues: offline-sync conflict (Balthasar's bug), older Android crash under investigation.

entries.title: Design review: inspection sync screen
entries.beats: Mercutio shows the sync-status screen for Schema Bridge in Balcony: 'queued', 'sent', 'needs attention'. Jokes about naming it 'the balcony scene'; Juliet vetoes. Romeo confirms the local queue makes 'queued' honest. Decision: show the count of queued inspections, never a spinner.

entries.title: Triage on the Balcony beta board
entries.beats: Kanban board 'Balcony 3.0 beta': Juliet moves cards: 'Offline sync conflict' to In progress (Balthasar), 'Android 11 crash' to In progress (Tybalt), 'Release notes' to Done, adds 'Sync status screen' (Mercutio).

entries.title: Voice memo: on the way in
entries.beats: Juliet, driving in, plans the day: Ducal Freight discovery call at 10:30 (first real customer call for Schema Bridge), sync with Romeo at 3 to settle field versioning, spec v2 written by end of day. Wants the standup short. Reminds herself, again, to book the Paris trade-show flight.

entries.title: Morning inbox
entries.beats: Inbox list: Balthasar Davi 'Overnight QA run: 6 devices', Paris Duke 'Re: Wednesday call', Angela Nurse 'Release checklist (80%)', 'Balcony beta crash digest' (automated), Lawrence Friar 'Friday'. Juliet opens Balthasar's QA report: offline-sync conflict fix holds on 5 of 6 devices; the sixth is the old Android 11 tablet, which crashes opening the camera; one flaky photo upload on slow wifi.

entries.title: Reading Paris Duke's email
entries.beats: Same inbox; opens Paris Duke's reply confirming 10:30 today. He lists what he wants to cover: how inspectors work offline in the yards, what auditors need, and how inspections would reach Ducal's freight system. Asks if 45 minutes is ok.

entries.title: Catching up on #balcony-beta
entries.beats: Team chat channel #balcony-beta. Done (earlier) messages: Tybalt late last night 'found it, I think: the photo cache path on Android 11', Balthasar 'nice, I'll rerun at 8'. New: Balthasar 'rerun: no crash on the Android 11 tablet with Tybalt's branch', Angela 'checklist at 80%, QA sign-off is the big one left', Juliet types 'great work both. standup at 9:30, let's keep it to 10 min'.

entries.title: Balcony beta board, morning
entries.beats: Board 'Balcony 3.0 beta' (columns To do / In progress / Review / Done). Juliet moves 'Android 11 crash' (Tybalt) from In progress to Review, leaves 'Offline sync conflict' (Balthasar) in Review, adds 'QA sign-off' (Balthasar) to To do.

entries.title: Reply to Paris Duke
entries.beats: Email to Paris Duke, subject 'Re: Wednesday call': 45 minutes is fine; she'll cover how Balcony works offline today, what a signed report could look like, and Schema Bridge in a sentence; she'd love to hear how a yard inspection actually goes. Signs 'Juliet'.

entries.title: Reading about Ducal Freight
entries.beats: Web page ducal-freight.example/about, 'About Ducal Freight': a regional freight company in the Mountain West, 30 yards and cross-docks, inspections of every trailer at the dock, a line about safety audits. Juliet reads down the page.

entries.title: Ducal call prep

entries.title: Ducal call prep, questions
entries.beats: Same doc; earlier sections already there (done). Juliet adds 'Questions': how many inspectors per yard; paper today or an app; who signs; how long until an auditor needs the report; which system the inspections end up in; would they want Montague's routing data (expect: no).

entries.title: DM with Benvolio about Friday
entries.beats: Direct messages with Benvolio Montague. Done: Benvolio yesterday 'Friday demo for Ducal still at 2?' New: Juliet 'yes, and I'm talking to Paris at 10:30 today, I'll confirm with him', Benvolio 'perfect. Romeo's been poking at the queue since he got in', Juliet 'ha, tell him to keep going'.

Juliet types a comment line under QA sign-off: 'Android 11 fix needs one more pass on the old tablet.'

entries.title: Wednesday priorities
entries.beats: Juliet's own notes doc 'Wed'. Typed list: Ducal call 10:30; spec v2 today, not tomorrow; settle versioning with Romeo at 3; Angela: QA sign-off timing; Mercutio: signed PDF look; book the Paris flight (the trade show is the 26th).

entries.title: #schema-bridge with Romeo
entries.beats: Channel #schema-bridge. New messages: Romeo 'queue prototype's holding up. I'll do a proper offline run this afternoon', Juliet 'that's the demo right there', Romeo 'want to see it at 3?', Juliet 'yes. and I want to leave that meeting with an owner for field versioning', Romeo 'deal'.

entries.title: Standup notes
entries.beats: Doc 'Standup, Wed', headings done. Juliet types under Tybalt: 'Android 11 crash fixed: photo-cache path. In review.'; under Angela: 'checklist 80%; needs QA sign-off from Balthasar'; under Me: 'Romeo's queue covers the uptime worry'; Tybalt: 'fine if it survives a week of airplane mode'.

entries.title: Standup notes, after
entries.beats: Same doc, all notes done; Juliet adds 'Actions': Balthasar QA pass on old tablet today; airplane-mode test needs an owner (Tybalt's bar: a week offline); Juliet ask Romeo how long the queue has run offline.

entries.title: Ducal call prep, final

entries.beats: Email to Angela Nurse, subject 'QA sign-off timing': can Balthasar sign off Thursday afternoon, so Friday's go/no-go has nothing open; she'll check the old tablet herself if that helps.

entries.title: Angela's reply
entries.beats: Inbox; opens Angela Nurse 'Re: QA sign-off timing': Balthasar can do Thursday 3:30; she's booking a check-in with the three of them; checklist will be at 95% by then.

Juliet comments 'thanks for the clear write-up' and 'can we add the old tablet to the device list for CI?'; approves.

entries.title: Notes: what a signed report needs
entries.beats: New doc 'Signed reports: scratch'. Juliet types: inspector name and signature; time signed; site; photos with times; findings; a page per inspection; can't be edited after signing; auditor can check it wasn't changed.

entries.title: Signed reports, continued
entries.beats: Same doc, earlier lines done. Adds 'Questions for Paris': does their auditor need a PDF or will a link do; how long do they keep reports; is one signature enough.

entries.title: Quick word with Romeo
entries.beats: #schema-bridge. Juliet 'on with Ducal in 5. anything you want me to ask?', Romeo 'ask if they ever need to edit an inspection after it's signed', Juliet 'good one'.

Asks for three things: inspections that sync when back online, a signed PDF per inspection, and export to their freight system by site. Asks whether Ducal can see Montague's routing data; Juliet says only what Ducal sends. Paris agrees to Friday's demo.

entries.title: Ducal call notes

entries.title: Ducal call notes, the three asks

entries.title: Ducal call notes, wrap-up
entries.beats: Same doc. Adds: asked whether Ducal sees Montague's routing data; I said only what Ducal sends; he agreed to Friday's demo at 2; follow up with a recap email today.

entries.title: Recap email to Paris Duke
entries.beats: Email to Paris Duke, subject 'Thanks, and Friday': thanks for the time; what she heard (three asks); Friday at 2 they'll show an inspection made offline syncing and a signed PDF; export by site comes after; Benvolio Montague will send the invite.

entries.title: Quick call with Angela
entries.beats: Angela and Juliet on the release: checklist moving to 85%, Balthasar signs off Thursday 3:30, go/no-go stays Friday 9:30, Angela drafts the announcement once it's a go. Juliet asks her to add the old Android 11 tablet to the standing device list. Short and friendly.

Juliet adds 'Spec v2' (Juliet) to Doing, 'Signed PDF per inspection' (Mercutio) to To do, 'Export by site' to To do, 'Friday demo for Ducal' (Benvolio) to Doing.

entries.title: Note from Friar

entries.beats: Web page docs.example/signed-records, 'Signing records you can trust later': sign at the moment of capture, include the time, keep the original, show a check that the file hasn't changed since. Juliet reads.

entries.title: Signed reports, after reading
entries.beats: Doc 'Signed reports: scratch', earlier lines done. Juliet adds: signature and time stamped on the device at signing; a short check code printed on the PDF; corrections are new inspections that point to the old one.

entries.beats: Direct messages with Mercutio Escalus. Mercutio 'heard you want a signed pdf. do you want it pretty or do you want it boring?', Juliet 'boring and trustworthy', Mercutio 'my favourite kind of pretty. 2:30?', Juliet '2:30'.

entries.title: Updating the beta release notes
entries.beats: Doc 'Balcony App 3.0 beta: release notes', earlier sections done (offline inspections, faster photo upload, signed reports). Juliet adds to What's new: sync status (queued, sent, needs attention, with a count) and how to send feedback.

entries.title: Release notes, known issues
entries.beats: Same doc. Juliet types 'Thanks to our 41 beta testers.' and a note to herself to update Known issues after Thursday's check-in.

entries.title: Balthasar's device run
entries.beats: #balcony-beta. Balthasar posts device results one line each: Pixel-class phone pass, two tablets pass, old Android 11 tablet pass with Tybalt's branch, iPhone pass, iPad pass. Juliet 'six for six!'.

entries.title: Inbox before lunch
entries.beats: Inbox; opens Benvolio Montague 'Invite: Schema Bridge demo for Ducal Freight' Friday 2:00 to 2:45, with Paris Duke, Romeo, Juliet; Juliet reads it.

entries.title: Beta feedback page
entries.beats: Web page beta.capulet.example/feedback, 'Balcony 3.0 beta feedback': tester comments, e.g. 'offline mode saved me in the basement', 'photo upload slow on hotel wifi', 'love the signed report', 'wish I could search past inspections'. Juliet scrolls.

entries.title: Beta feedback, more

entries.title: After lunch
entries.beats: #balcony-beta. Done: messages from lunch time. New: Tybalt 'looked at the slow-wifi photo stall: it resumes on its own, not a blocker', Juliet 'love it. writing spec v2 now, ping me if you need me'.

entries.title: Quick inbox check
entries.beats: Inbox; opens Paris Duke 'Re: Thanks, and Friday': got it, Friday at 2 works, their auditor may join for the PDF part.

entries.title: Re-reading spec draft 1
entries.beats: Doc 'Schema Bridge: draft 1', all blocks done (Goal; Inspection record fields site_id, inspector, photos, findings, signed_at; Sync nightly batch; Open questions). Juliet types a line at the top: 'v2 today: Ducal asks, events, versioning.'

entries.title: Schema Bridge spec v2
entries.beats: Juliet revises the doc to 'Schema Bridge: v2': adds Ducal Freight requirements (offline sync, signed PDF, export by site), changes sync from nightly batch to events with a local queue, adds field-versioning section with an empty 'Owner:' line still TBD.

entries.title: Spec v2: Ducal requirements
entries.beats: Doc 'Schema Bridge: v2'. Done: intro paragraph and Goal. Juliet types 'Ducal Freight requirements' detail: offline sync with no manual resend; a signed PDF per inspection within 24 hours; export by site to Ducal's freight system; Ducal sees only its own data.

entries.title: Spec v2: inspection record
entries.beats: Same doc. Done: requirements. Types 'Inspection record' with fields and a sentence each: site_id, inspector, photos (each with a time), findings, signed_at, and a new field schema_version.

entries.title: Spec v2: signing
entries.beats: Same doc. Types 'Signing': signed on the device at the moment of signing; signature and time printed on the PDF; a short check code; a signed inspection is never edited, a correction is a new inspection pointing to the old one.

entries.title: Spec v2: sync by events
entries.beats: Same doc. Types 'Sync': each inspection is sent as an event when signed; events wait in a local queue on the device; the queue drains when the connection returns; Balcony keeps working when Mesh Routing is down.

entries.title: Spec v2: what the inspector sees
entries.beats: Same doc. Types 'What the inspector sees' from Tuesday's design review: three states, queued, sent, needs attention; show how many inspections are queued; never a spinner.

entries.title: Spec v2: queue limits
entries.beats: Same doc. Types 'Queue limits': open question how big the queue can get; a tablet offline for a week in a busy yard might hold a few thousand events; ask Romeo for a cap.

entries.title: Spec v2: export by site
entries.beats: Same doc. Types 'Export by site (next sprint)': inspections grouped by site_id; a daily file or a feed, Ducal's choice; out of scope for Friday.

entries.title: Asking Romeo about event size
entries.beats: #schema-bridge. Juliet 'how big is one event with 10 photos?', Romeo 'photos go separately, the event is a few KB', Juliet 'so a cap of 10k events is fine?', Romeo 'more than fine. I'll put it in the PR'.

entries.title: Spec v2: queue cap
entries.beats: Doc 'Schema Bridge: v2', queue section done. Juliet types 'Cap: 10,000 events per device. Photos upload separately and resume on their own.'

entries.title: Spec v2: failure cases
entries.beats: Same doc. Types 'When things go wrong': Mesh Routing down (queue holds); tablet lost before sync (inspection lost, same as paper today, say so); duplicate send (events carry an id made on the device, receiver ignores repeats).

entries.title: Spec v2: testing
entries.beats: Same doc. Types 'Testing': an airplane-mode test (owner TBD; Tybalt's bar is a week); Balthasar's six-device run; Friday demo shows an inspection made offline syncing on reconnect.

entries.title: Spec v2: privacy line
entries.beats: Same doc. Types 'Who sees what': Capulet sees inspections; Montague sees the routing envelope, not the findings; Ducal sees only its own sites.

entries.title: Reading Mesh Routing docs
entries.beats: Web page docs.montague.example/mesh-routing/events, 'Mesh Routing: sending events': each event has an envelope (id, sender, destination, schema_version, sent_at) and a body; receivers acknowledge; retries with backoff. Juliet reads.

entries.title: Spec v2: the envelope
entries.beats: Doc 'Schema Bridge: v2'. Types 'Envelope (Montague)': id, sender, destination, schema_version, sent_at; the inspection record is the body (Capulet).

entries.title: #balcony-beta check-in
entries.beats: #balcony-beta. Angela 'Thursday 3:30 check-in booked with Balthasar', Juliet 'thank you', Balthasar 'I'll bring the old tablet'.

entries.title: Spec v2: timeline
entries.beats: Doc 'Schema Bridge: v2'. Types 'Timeline': Friday demo for Ducal; pilot if they want one; export by site next sprint.

entries.title: Spec v2: open questions
entries.beats: Same doc, sections done. Types 'Open questions': field versioning owner (Romeo at 3); export by site timing; does Ducal's auditor want anything else on the PDF.

entries.title: Signed PDF chat with Mercutio
entries.beats: Mercutio shows ideas for the signed inspection PDF: site and inspector at the top, photos with their times, findings, signature and time at the bottom with a short check code. Juliet wants it plain enough that an auditor trusts it. Mercutio jokes he'll make boring beautiful. They agree: one page per inspection, no logos except a small Ducal one if asked.

entries.title: Notes during the PDF chat
entries.beats: New doc 'Signed PDF: layout'. Juliet types: top: site, inspector, date; middle: findings, photos with times; bottom: signature, time signed, check code; one page per inspection; plain.

entries.title: Signed PDF layout, after
entries.beats: Same doc, done. Adds 'Mercutio: a mock by Thursday' and 'Ask Paris on Friday: does their auditor want anything else on it?'

entries.title: Board after the PDF chat
entries.beats: Board 'Schema Bridge'. Juliet moves 'Signed PDF per inspection' (Mercutio) from To do to Doing; adds 'Queue cap 10k' (Romeo) to Doing.

entries.title: Agenda for the Romeo sync
entries.beats: New doc 'Sync with Romeo, 3pm'. Juliet types: 1. Paris's three asks, 2. see the queue prototype, 3. decide field versioning: who owns what, how changes are agreed, 4. Friday demo plan.

entries.title: Romeo ready
entries.beats: #schema-bridge. Romeo 'queue's been offline since about two. 12 inspections queued, nothing lost. ready when you are', Juliet 'two minutes'.

entries.title: Agenda, last look

entries.title: Schema Bridge sync with Romeo
entries.beats: Juliet walks Romeo through Paris Duke's three asks. Romeo demos the queue prototype surviving an hour offline. They decide field versioning: Capulet owns the inspection record schema, Montague owns the routing envelope, any change needs both to approve. Romeo will add a schema version number to every event. Plan for Friday's demo: show an offline inspection syncing and the signed PDF.

entries.title: Notes during the Romeo sync
entries.beats: Doc 'Sync with Romeo, 3pm', agenda done. Juliet types 'Notes': walked Romeo through the three asks; prototype survived an hour offline, nothing lost.

entries.title: Romeo sync: versioning decided

entries.title: Tybalt's reply

entries.title: Spec v2: corrections note
entries.beats: Same doc. Types under Signing: 'A correction shows on the PDF with a pointer to the inspection it corrects.'

entries.title: Balcony board, end of day
entries.beats: Board 'Balcony 3.0 beta'. Juliet moves 'Android 11 crash' (Tybalt) to Done, 'Offline sync conflict' (Balthasar) to Done, leaves 'QA sign-off' in To do, adds 'Announcement' (Angela) to In progress.

entries.title: Spec v2 is up
entries.beats: #schema-bridge. Juliet 'spec v2 is up. versioning section filled in, queue cap 10k, corrections as new inspections', Romeo 'reading tonight', Benvolio 'thank you!'.

entries.title: Thursday list
entries.beats: Juliet's notes doc 'Thu'. Types: 10:00 Tybalt about the versioning rule; review Romeo's queue PR; 3:30 check-in with Angela and Balthasar; record the backup demo video; Mercutio's PDF mock.

entries.title: Clearing the inbox
entries.beats: Inbox; mostly read rows; opens the vendor invoice for test devices and marks it for Angela.

entries.title: Flights again
entries.beats: Web page flights.example/search again, same Denver to Paris search; prices slightly up; she closes the tab without booking.

entries.title: Thursday list, done
entries.beats: Doc 'Thu', list done. Adds 'Write the weekly note to Friar Friday: Balcony, versioning, Ducal'.

entries.title: Voice memo: end of day
entries.beats: Recap: Ducal's three asks, versioning decided with Romeo and already in the spec, tell Friar on Friday. Reminder to book the Paris flight, which she still hasn't done.

entries.title: Signing off
entries.beats: #balcony-beta. Juliet 'heading out. great day, everyone', Angela 'night!', Tybalt 'night'.

entries.title: 1:1 with Tybalt
entries.beats: Tybalt pushes back on the shared versioning rule: worries Montague will slow Capulet down. Juliet explains it covers only the inspection record, not Balcony's internals. They agree on a 48-hour review window so neither side blocks the other. Tybalt volunteers to write the airplane-mode test.

entries.title: Reviewing Romeo's queue pull request
entries.beats: Code review view of a pull request 'schema-bridge: local event queue with schema_version' by Romeo Montague: diff adds a schema_version field and a retry loop with backoff. Juliet leaves comments: 'nice', 'can the queue cap at 10k events?', approves.

entries.title: Release check-in with Angela and Balthasar
entries.beats: Balthasar confirms the offline-sync conflict fix holds on 6 devices; one flaky photo upload left on slow networks, not a blocker. Angela has the checklist at 95%. Plan: go/no-go stays Friday 9:30.

entries.title: Balcony App 3.0 go/no-go
entries.beats: Walk the checklist. Tybalt's airplane-mode test passed. Balthasar: slow-network photo upload known issue, documented. Decision: go, staged rollout 10% Monday, 100% Thursday. Angela sends the announcement.

entries.title: Weekly note to Friar
entries.beats: Juliet writes an email to Friar (Verona Ventures), subject 'Week of Feb 9': Balcony 3.0 is a go; Schema Bridge has its versioning rule agreed with Montague (Capulet owns the record, Montague owns the envelope, 48-hour review); Ducal Freight demo today; ask: an intro to a second logistics pilot.

entries.title: Schema Bridge demo for Ducal Freight
entries.beats: Benvolio opens. Romeo shows an inspection made offline syncing when the tablet reconnects. Juliet shows the signed PDF. Paris Duke is pleased, asks for export by site, which is next sprint. Paris agrees to a four-week pilot at two sites starting March 2. Paris mentions he's at a conference in Denver next week.

entries.title: Voice memo: the week
entries.beats: Reflects: Balcony is a go, Ducal pilot agreed for March 2, versioning settled. Next week: export by site, rollout watch. Finally books the Paris flight for the trade show on the 26th.
